Subject: Follow-up: Procurement & Payment Path (PO vs Card) — Redwood inference

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: FinTechCo is evaluating embedding LLM features for transaction categorization and insights, target go-live in Q1. A few procurement items we flagged on the call I wanted to summarize and confirm next steps on:

- Payment method: you mentioned AP prefers issuing POs for vendor commitments > $10k/month, and corporate card only for ad-hoc or small purchases. Can you confirm the approval threshold and whether card is possible for an initial pilot under $5k?
- Vendor onboarding: procurement asked for SOC2 report, insurance cert, and W9. I attached our SOC2 summary and standard SLA for procurement review.
- Contracting: sounds like your legal prefers a PO + negotiated SOW for platform usage rather than full Master Services Agreement initially. Is that correct?
- Marketplace: you asked whether we are available on the CloudMarketplace — we are listed on two marketplaces; happy to route billing there if procurement prefers.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send the SOC2 summary + standard SLA (attached) and a draft pricing quote for a 3-month pilot keyed to API usage.
2) If procurement confirms PO path, I’ll create a PO-ready invoice and DocuSign quote for signatures.
3) If card is required for faster pilot, we can accept card for up to $7,500/month for initial term (we can toggle payment method later).

Can you confirm procurement contact(s) for formal onboarding and whether you want the quote routed through the marketplace? Happy to sync again with procurement on Monday if that helps.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

www.redwood.inference

Hi Lauren — great to chat yesterday. Confirming details from our side:

- AP policy: For any recurring vendor spend above $10k/month we require a PO and standard vendor onboarding (SOC2 + insurance + W9). For pilots under $5k/month, procurement can sometimes approve payment by corporate card to expedite testing, but this requires AMEX approval and an internal spend justification.
- Vendor onboarding: procurement@fintechco.com is the right inbox; they prefer receiving a single ZIP with SOC2, COI, and W9. Do you have a consolidated zip you can share?
- Marketplace: We prefer marketplace billing when possible because it simplifies procurement and tax handling. Are you on the FinCloud Marketplace? If so, please share the listing link and the SKU/pricing.

Next steps from our side: procurement will review SOC2/SLA this week. I’ll flag the pilot for card payment approval to see if we can keep the onboarding light and speed up the pilot. If AP requires PO, we’ll need a quoted amount and an invoice template.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Product | FinTechCo
samantha@fintechco.com
